sources.excerpt: My Gear Messages Member Gear Explore Brands Effect Types Loading product… Gearaffe - Discover Your Perfect Guitar Gear My Gear Messages Member Gear Explore Brands Effect Types Home / Brands / Cornerstone Music Gear / Gladio SC YouTube Gladio SC Cornerstone Music Gear An amp-like overdrive and preamp pedal with parallel drive architecture and clean blend control, designed for touch-sensitive dynamic response and always-on use. Overdrive Search on Amazon Opens Amazon search results for this gear • Affiliate link Sign in to add About this pedal The Gladio SC combines clean and overdriven signals in parallel to preserve tone clarity and articulation. It features a clean blend knob for mixing pure guitar signal with driven tone, dynamic compression switching for adjustable response, and a dual-amp feel that simulates playing through both clean and driven amplifiers simultaneously. The pedal is designed to enhance rather than reshape your guitar and amplifier, responding naturally to playing dynamics.
